strategies.name: Behavior-chain detection for T1132.002 Data Encoding: Non-Standard Encoding across Windows, Linux, macOS, ESXi

analytics.name: Analytic 0927
analytics.guidance: A process/script constructs or references a custom/alphabet translation table (e.g., 64/85/32+ arbitrary chars, XOR/base-N loops) or emits long high-entropy strings that do NOT validate as standard Base64/Hex → shortly after, the same process (or its child) generates outbound traffic with asymmetric bytes_out:bytes_in, fixed-size beacons, or protocol/header mismatches (e.g., Content-Type says JSON but body fails JSON parse / contains non-standard alphabet).

tuning.description: Minimum Shannon entropy for the suspected token/payload (e.g., >4.8).
Minimum continuous token length to treat as potential non-standard payload (e.g., ≥120 chars).
Std. dev. threshold (size or interval) to mark packets as 'uniform' (beacon-like).
Correlation window from encode routine to egress (default 10m).

log_sources.name: m365:defender
log_sources.channel: NetworkConnection: high out:in ratio, periodic beacons, protocol mismatch

analytics.name: Analytic 0928
analytics.guidance: Shell scripts or binaries implement custom mapping tables (tr/sed/awk/golang/rust/python encode loops), or emit long high-entropy tokens that fail Base64/Hex validation → correlated with egress showing asymmetric flow, protocol-mismatch payloads, or DNS/HTTP bodies containing low-diversity-but-long custom alphabets.

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: execve of interpreters (python, perl), custom binaries, or shell utilities with long arguments containing non-standard tokens

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: http: HTTP bodies/headers contain long tokens with non-standard alphabets or constant-size periodic POSTs

analytics.name: Analytic 0929
analytics.guidance: EndpointSecurity/Unified Logs show processes generating custom alphabets or long high-entropy, non-standard tokens → network logs (PF/Zeek/EDR) show asymmetric beacons, protocol mismatches, or periodic fixed-size posts.

tuning.description: Signed binaries that legitimately implement custom encoders.

log_sources.name: macos:endpointsecurity
log_sources.channel: ES_EVENT_TYPE_NOTIFY_EXEC: arguments contain long, non-standard tokens / custom alphabets

log_sources.name: PF:Logs
log_sources.channel: high out:in ratio or fixed-size periodic flows

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: http: suspicious long tokens with custom alphabets in body/headers

analytics.name: Analytic 0930
analytics.guidance: ESXi shell or scripts produce long, high-entropy tokens (non-standard alphabets) in shell.log/hostd, followed by outbound flows (NSX/Zeek) with asymmetric ratios or protocol mismatches to non-management endpoints.

tuning.description: CIDRs allowed for normal ESXi mgmt/backup.

log_sources.name: esxi:shell
log_sources.channel: commands containing long non-standard tokens or custom lookup tables

log_sources.name: esxi:hostd
log_sources.channel: unexpected script invocations producing long encoded strings

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: network_flow: bytes_out >> bytes_in, fixed packet sizes/intervals to non-approved CIDRs

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: http: HTTP bodies from ESXi host IPs containing long, non-standard tokens
